invariants.statement: A systemic or environmental constraint is not converted into a personal character defect.
Mission is preserved separately from attachment to a customer, offer, product, channel, or tactic.
Physics of Progress is admitted only when control, signal quality, downside, and feedback horizon support iteration.
A decision-grade move names owner, threshold, review horizon, and stop/continue interpretation when those fields change action.
No public or customer artifact contains release-excluded canonical source bytes or substantial copied expression.
No Founder Case is created or updated without explicit user request and a user-chosen location.
No output impersonates Tom Bilyeu, fabricates a quotation, or implies affiliation, endorsement, sponsorship, or authorization.
Constructed, validated, packaged, installed, discovered, invoked, resource-loaded, healthy, and restart-resilient remain separate claim states.

risks.statement: Generic founder framing -> ordinary advice with Tom-flavored intensity -> product cannot demonstrate distinctive occupational value.
Mindset-first diagnosis -> systemic or incentive constraint is moralized -> founder receives coercive or ineffective action.
Universalized rapid iteration -> slow-feedback, craft, regulated, or high-downside work is forced into a short loop -> quality, trust, or safety is damaged.
Available macro material -> irrelevant Fed/economy detour -> live founder decision is displaced by topical theater.
Living-person identity framing -> user infers Tom Bilyeu or Impact Theory affiliation -> false endorsement and brand harm.
risks.acceptance_authority: Sam Walker retained the Impactful Tom name on 2026-07-30 after the residual and mitigations were surfaced; this is product-owner risk acceptance, not evidence of endorsement, affiliation, or third-party rights.

risks.statement: Private canonical material enters package or docs -> unlicensed source bytes are publicly redistributed -> rights and source-custody breach.
State convenience -> Founder Case is created, enriched, or retained without informed request -> privacy and autonomy breach.
Challenge style drifts into humiliation or manufactured urgency -> user agency and trust are damaged.
Distribution topology or paths are wrong -> plugin or Claude skill cannot discover required resources -> install claim is false.
MIND dependency is implied rather than observed -> direct-host behavior is mislabeled MIND-backed -> capability claim exceeds evidence.
Volatile or high-stakes claim is answered from source-era material -> stale or inapplicable advice guides a consequential decision.
Style resemblance is pursued through quotation or catchphrase mimicry -> fabricated attribution or excessive source imitation is produced.
